# glinet_sqm_service (Resource)

Manage the stock SQM service singleton. Queue sections are managed by glinet_sqm.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `autorate` (Boolean) Enable automatic rate estimation.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `download` (Number) Global download limit in kbit/s.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable SQM.
- `qdisc` (String) Default queueing discipline.
- `upload` (Number) Global upload limit in kbit/s.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
